role.id: Mentor Olimpiade Sains Nasional Bidang Komputer/Informatika

summary.en: Facilitated structured mentoring focused on building strong computational thinking, problem decomposition, and algorithmic reasoning skills, emphasizing transferable problem-solving frameworks over competition-specific tactics.
summary.id: Memfasilitasi mentoring terstruktur dengan fokus pada penguatan computational thinking, dekomposisi masalah, dan penalaran algoritmik, dengan menekankan kerangka problem solving yang transferable dibandingkan sekadar taktik lomba.

achievements.en: Designed a learning approach that prioritizes understanding problem constraints, edge cases, and solution trade-offs before implementation.
achievements.id: Merancang pendekatan belajar yang memprioritaskan pemahaman batasan masalah, edge case, dan trade-off solusi sebelum implementasi.

achievements.en: Guided learners to translate abstract problem statements into structured solution models using step-by-step reasoning.
achievements.id: Membimbing peserta menerjemahkan soal abstrak menjadi model solusi terstruktur melalui penalaran bertahap.

achievements.en: Instilled habits of writing intentional, concise, and maintainable code rather than brute-force or trial-and-error solutions.
achievements.id: Menanamkan kebiasaan menulis kode yang terencana, ringkas, dan mudah dirawat dibandingkan solusi brute-force atau trial-and-error.

achievements.en: Strengthened learners’ confidence in tackling unfamiliar problems by applying systematic analysis instead of memorized patterns.
achievements.id: Menguatkan kepercayaan diri peserta dalam menghadapi masalah baru dengan menerapkan analisis sistematis alih-alih pola hafalan.
